consent_evidence_one_subject_check.name: consent_evidence_one_subject_check
consent_evidence_one_subject_check.value: (("user_id" IS NOT NULL)::integer + ("inquiry_id" IS NOT NULL)::integer) = 1

consent_evidence_purpose_subject_check.name: consent_evidence_purpose_subject_check
consent_evidence_purpose_subject_check.value:
(
      ("purpose" IN ('account_terms', 'account_privacy') AND "user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inquiry_id" IS NULL)
      OR ("purpose" = 'inquiry_privacy' AND "user_id" IS NULL AND "inquiry_id" IS NOT NULL)
    )
